rules.reason: Generic payload contracts cannot import concrete values or engines.
Pure values, slots and lattice laws remain independently testable.
Inject CandidateOracle and IntrinsicProvider; composition owns conversions.
Core solver works with providers and observer disabled.
New core services and state are owned by each AnalysisSession.
Legacy CFG-era closure cannot silently diverge from active frontend closure.

rules.require: old public imports delegate to new implementation; new implementation never calls old public shims
parse and model target source without importing or executing target code

transition.existing_engine_edges: Reported as explicit debt in migration mode and enforced in release mode.
transition.dynamic_imports: Function-local imports and literal importlib/__import__ calls are inspected; nonliteral dynamic imports require manual review.
transition.native_isolation: Legacy native can use process isolation during transition; this is not evidence of new core isolation.
